# Castle Garage Doors & Gates

> Family-owned & operated garage door and gate contractor serving San Diego County to Riverside County, California, since 1981. Authorized Home Depot Service Provider and Clopay Authorized Dealer. Licensed, bonded and insured — CSLB #1154002 (C-61/D-28 Door Systems).

Site: https://castlegarage.com
Legal entity: Castle Garage Inc (dba Castle Garage Doors & Gates)

## Services
- Garage door repair: springs, cables, rollers, drums, tracks, panels, sensors, 24/7 emergency
- New garage door installation: residential, commercial, custom (Clopay authorized dealer)
- Garage door openers: installation and repair (LiftMaster, Genie, Marantec; smart/Wi-Fi)
- Gate services: driveway, automatic/electric, security gates, gate operators, repair
- Castle Restoration: rebuild of an existing door's moving hardware with Lifetime Parts Protection

## Pricing
- Service call / annual tune-up: $125 (applied toward any repair)
- Spring replacement: starts at $600, parts and labor
- No repair is priced below $125. Every job is quoted in full before work begins.

## Warranty
- 1 year parts and labor on work purchased directly from Castle
- Castle Restoration: lifetime parts protection on installed springs, cables, rollers, bearings, drums and torsion tube; 1-year labor (3-year on Restoration Premium); annual Castle maintenance keeps it active
- Purchases made through Home Depot or another retailer are warranted by that retailer

## Hours
Mon–Fri 7:00 AM–6:00 PM · Sat 8:00 AM–12:00 PM · Sun closed. 24/7 emergency repair available.

## Service area
Bonsall, Carlsbad, Corona, Del Mar, Encinitas, Escondido, Fallbrook, La Jolla, Murrieta, North County, Oceanside, Rancho Santa Fe, Riverside County, San Diego, Temecula
